name: Industry Context Generator
description: Generate one reusable global Industry Context profile from the canonical schema.

canonical_default.markdown: Generate one complete Industry Context profile for {{context_name}} in {{language}} for {{market}}, strictly following the canonical Industry Context JSON Schema and its embedded descriptions/rules; use null for genuinely unknown values and return JSON only.

notes: The editable prompt stays intentionally small; runtime appends the canonical core JSON Schema.
